name: Animals In The House
overview: Scripture reveals that God has entrusted mankind with dominion over all creatures, including those within the home, as seen in Genesis 1:26. The righteous are called to care for their animals with compassion and respect, reflecting God's own mercy (Proverbs 12:10). Moreover, even the beasts and birds testify to God's wisdom and majesty (Job 12:7), and all living things that have breath are called to praise the Lord (Psalms 150:6). The account in Judges 11:31 underscores the significance of what comes forth from the household, emphasizing a heart of dedication to God in all things under one's roof.
